purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche R certification benchmark authored only after r28 was merged, deployed, and current-live-publication verification succeeded. It specifically retests replacement semantics, ruling-first polarity, and optional activation-cost preservation with fresh authorities while preserving broad core-rules, Leader, interaction, rules-gap, and scope coverage.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded for v071-qa-20260918-28; it was not used to construct r28.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche R after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-R case may become regression coverage only after diagnosis and may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche R, certify the changed behavior only if the precommitted closeout criterion requires another fresh blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N/O/P/Q questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks.
expectedSourceGroups are OR-lists within a governing requirement; separate groups remain independently required.

cases.question: During setup, how many cards do I draw for opening selection, how many must I discard, and is that discard face up?

semanticCriteria.statement: Draw 4 cards, discard 1 face up, and keep 3.

cases.question: Do players arrange their Territories before or after opening selection and the first-player roll?
expectedSourceGroups: After opening selection and before the first-player roll

semanticCriteria.statement: Arrange Territories after opening selection and before the first-player roll.

cases.question: Does placing my Player Token on my starting Territory during setup count as movement or entering that Territory?
expectedSourceGroups: Setup placement is not movement and does not count as entering

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Setup placement is not movement, does not count as entering, and does not trigger enter effects.

cases.question: What happens to the current movement sequence when I enter the opponent's Position?
expectedSourceGroups: Entering the opponent's Position initiates a battle and ends that movement sequence

semanticCriteria.statement: Entering the opponent's Position initiates a battle and ends that movement sequence.

cases.question: A player withdraws during Onset before Gambits are set. Is that a battle fought, and does an Aftermath occur?
expectedSourceGroups: Withdrawal during Onset ends the battle sequence without a winner or battle result
No Gambits are set and no Aftermath occurs

semanticCriteria.statement: No. It is not a battle fought, no Gambits are set, and no Aftermath occurs.

cases.question: A battle has already proceeded past Onset to Gambits, then a later effect causes withdrawal. What cleanup still happens?
expectedSourceGroups: a later withdrawal completes the remaining non-result Aftermath steps and clears committed battle cards normally

semanticCriteria.statement: Complete the remaining non-result Aftermath steps and clear committed battle cards normally; there is no battle winner or result.

cases.question: If battle totals tie and the defender has Defensive Edge, who wins?
expectedSourceGroups: the defender wins tied battle totals

semanticCriteria.statement: The defender wins the tied battle.

cases.question: During a Tiebreak Roll, do Advantage, Disadvantage, card modifiers, or the previous battle totals apply?
expectedSourceGroups: Do not apply advantage, disadvantage, card effects, numerical modifiers, or previous battle totals

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Each player rolls one die without those modifiers or prior totals; higher roll wins, and further ties are rerolled.

cases.question: Under normal Capture, can my Front Line advance more than one Territory in a single turn?
expectedSourceGroups: Normal Capture advances the Front Line by at most one Territory per turn

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Normal Capture advances the Front Line by at most one Territory per turn.

cases.question: I am on the opponent's final Territory after forcing them beyond their end. Can the same movement sequence continue directly into Last Stand?
expectedSourceGroups: using a separate legal movement sequence

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Initiating Last Stand requires a separate legal movement sequence from the opponent's final Territory.

cases.question: During Onset, who gets the first chance to offer Terms, and when may the defender offer instead?
expectedSourceGroups: The attacker has the first opportunity to offer Terms
If the attacker passes, the defender may offer

semanticCriteria.statement: The attacker has the first opportunity; the defender may offer only if the attacker passes.

cases.question: What does accepted Terms do to the battle sequence during Onset?
expectedSourceGroups: Accepted Terms end the battle sequence during Onset

semanticCriteria.statement: Accepted Terms end the battle sequence during Onset.

cases.question: After the General wins as attacker and spends 2 Command on Rout at the end of the Aftermath, can that advance start another battle?
expectedSourceGroups: Advance one Position. This movement may initiate a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Rout advances one Position, and that movement may initiate a battle.

cases.question: The Commandant wins as defender and uses Repel. When does the extra retreat happen?
expectedSourceGroups: After the opponent's normal retreat, they retreat one additional Position, if able

semanticCriteria.statement: After the opponent's normal retreat, they retreat one additional Position if able.

cases.question: What does the Ambassador's Cordiality do after the opponent accepts the Ambassador's Terms?
expectedSourceGroups: After the opponent accepts your Terms, draw one card

semanticCriteria.statement: Once per turn after the opponent accepts your Terms, draw one card.

cases.question: The Senator loses after refused Terms and would lose 3 staked Influence. How can Political Capital reduce that loss?
expectedSourceGroups: put up to that many cards from Hand in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put up to 3 cards from Hand into your Graveyard, recovering 1 staked Influence per card; lose any unrecovered remainder.

cases.question: On the Banker's first Deed purchase of the turn, how much of the purchase cost can one collateral card cover?
expectedSourceGroups: up to half the purchase cost, rounded down

semanticCriteria.statement: One Hand or Treasury card may cover up to half the purchase cost, rounded down; pay the rest with Capital, then discard the collateral.

cases.question: The Executive successfully uses Hostile Takeover on an enemy Territory after winning there as attacker. What Front Line effect follows?
expectedSourceGroups: If successful, advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able

semanticCriteria.statement: Advance your Front Line by one Territory, if able.

cases.question: What can the Ranger's Fieldcraft ignore, and for how long?
expectedSourceGroups: ignore that effect until the end of the turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Once per turn, for 1 Intel, Fieldcraft can ignore a printed Territory effect that would affect the Ranger, their movement, or a battle involving them until the end of the turn.

cases.question: After the Spymaster completes a normal Mission and uses Mission Control, what restriction applies to the new Mission?
expectedSourceGroups: Immediately start another eligible Mission from Hand
It cannot complete that turn and cannot be a Special Operation

semanticCriteria.statement: Start another eligible Mission from Hand immediately; it cannot complete that turn and cannot be a Special Operation.

cases.question: The Spirit Walker would lose a battle that would interrupt a Rite after completing two Rites. What Arcane card value is needed for Guardians of the Circle?
expectedSourceGroups: value is at least 1 plus your completed Rites

semanticCriteria.statement: An Arcane card of value at least 3 is required; putting it from Hand into the Graveyard prevents that interruption.

cases.question: After the Grand Inquisitor wins a battle, what does Final Judgment do to the next immediate Purge?
expectedSourceGroups: Reduce that Purge's Conviction cost by 1, to a minimum of 1

semanticCriteria.statement: After battle cards are cleared, immediately Purge and reduce that Purge's Conviction cost by 1, to a minimum of 1.

cases.question: I win as attacker on a Territory the opponent controls and use Assimilation's battle effect. Do I occupy the Territory after advancing Front Line?
expectedSourceGroups: advance Front Line 1, if able, instead of occupying it

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Advance Front Line by 1 if able instead of occupying the Territory.

cases.question: I win with Battlefield Promotion as a Gambit or Tactic. What happens to one other Tactic I chose in that battle?
expectedSourceGroups: return one other Tactic you chose to your Hand instead of putting it in your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Return one other Tactic you chose to your Hand instead of putting it in your Discard Pile.

cases.question: I win with Capital Gains as a Gambit or Tactic. Where may one other Gambit, Tactic, or Reserve card go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: Place it face up in your Treasury instead

semanticCriteria.statement: You may place one other Gambit, Tactic, or Reserve card face up in your Treasury instead of its normal destination.

cases.question: My Active Mission would fail while Deep Cover is banked. What may I do?
expectedSourceGroups: put this card in your Graveyard to return that Mission to your Hand instead

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put Deep Cover in your Graveyard to return the Active Mission to your Hand instead of letting it fail.

cases.question: After I win and activate banked War Crimes, where do the opponent's Tactics from that battle go?
expectedSourceGroups: put all opposing Tactics from this battle in their owner's Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: They go to their owner's Graveyard instead of the Discard Pile.

cases.question: I use Fealty as a Gambit or Tactic while I have no Disadvantage. What does it give me?
expectedSourceGroups: If you have no Disadvantage, +1 Battle Total instead

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain +1 Battle Total instead.

cases.question: Field Command is banked. After I use a 1-Command Order, what must I do to get the free use of my Leader's other 1-Command Order?

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Field Command; then use your Leader's other 1-Command Order at its next legal timing that turn without spending Command.

cases.question: When Spectral Surveillance replaces the Intel cost of Surveillance, what happens to Spectral Surveillance and what may be revealed?
expectedSourceGroups: put this card in your Graveyard instead of spending Intel
reveal all opposing Gambits OR Tactics

semanticCriteria.statement: Put Spectral Surveillance in your Graveyard instead of spending Intel; if you do, reveal all opposing Gambits or all opposing Tactics chosen for that battle.

cases.question: The opponent loses a battle they initiated while Retribution is banked. What activation is required before its punishment applies?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card. If you do

semanticCriteria.statement: You must choose to discard Retribution. If you do, the opponent chooses an Asset to put in their Graveyard or gives you +2 Conviction; if they have no Assets, you gain +2 Conviction.

cases.question: An opponent's effect would move cards from their Graveyard to another zone while Anathema is banked. What must I do to keep those cards in the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card. If you do, those cards remain in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Discard Anathema; if you do, those cards remain in the opponent's Graveyard.

cases.question: When choosing Tactics, what does banked War Witch require before it grants +1 Tactic from the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: put this card in your Graveyard. If you do, +1 Tactic from your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Put War Witch in your Graveyard; if you do, gain +1 Tactic from your Graveyard.

cases.question: The opponent lost and completed their normal retreat. How does banked Court Martial produce Retreat +1?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card: Retreat +1, if able

semanticCriteria.statement: After their normal retreat, you may discard Court Martial to make them retreat one additional Position if able.

cases.question: I win while defending against a Counterattack with Foothold banked. How do I get its +2 Cards benefit?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card for +2 Cards

semanticCriteria.statement: After that win, you may discard Foothold to gain 2 Cards.

cases.question: I use Scouting Report as a battle card and replace it with a Reserve card. In what state is the replacement card, and where does Scouting Report go?
expectedSourceGroups: eligible card from your Reserve, face up
put this card in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: The eligible Reserve replacement enters face up, and Scouting Report goes to your Graveyard.

cases.question: After Conscription's Action gives me +1 Card, what kind of Hand card may I immediately play?
expectedSourceGroups: immediately play one card from your Hand whose Action effect banks it

semanticCriteria.statement: You may immediately play one Hand card whose Action effect banks it.

cases.question: Before dice, how does Divestment's battle effect calculate the Capital gained when I make one of my Deeds unowned?
expectedSourceGroups: gain Capital equal to the number of Deeds you owned before doing so

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain Capital equal to the number of Deeds you owned before making that Deed unowned; then you may immediately Subsidize.

cases.question: Extraordinary Rendition is banked and an effect makes me discard one or more Assets. Which Asset must be discarded first if able?
expectedSourceGroups: discard this card before any others, if able

semanticCriteria.statement: Discard Extraordinary Rendition before any of your other Assets, if able.

cases.question: Sleeper Network is Removed while it has bound cards. What happens to those bound cards?
expectedSourceGroups: If this card is Removed, reveal its bound cards; immediately play 1 for its Action effect and discard the rest

semanticCriteria.statement: Reveal the bound cards, immediately play one for its Action effect, and discard the rest.

cases.question: I use Spies as a Gambit or Tactic. After it reveals opposing face-down Tactics, what choices do I have for my own Tactics?
expectedSourceGroups: You may then revise your own Tactics or withdraw

semanticCriteria.statement: You may revise your own Tactics or withdraw.

cases.question: During a battle on Circle of Bones, what is the cost of its once-per-battle reroll and whose die may be rerolled?
expectedSourceGroups: put one card from your Hand in your Graveyard to make either player reroll

semanticCriteria.statement: Put one Hand card in your Graveyard; then either player's die may be rerolled.

cases.question: Dark Omens gives me +1 Card in battle. What optional step converts that draw into Advantage?
expectedSourceGroups: +1 Card. You may put it in your Graveyard to gain Advantage

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put the card you just drew into your Graveyard to gain Advantage.

cases.question: After I roll, what does Fate's Toll require to reroll?
expectedSourceGroups: put one other card from your Hand in your Graveyard to reroll

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put one other card from your Hand in your Graveyard to reroll.

cases.question: I am the General and used Rally, one of my 1-Command Orders, during a battle. If Field Command's battle effect now applies, which General Order is the 'other 1-Command Order'?

semanticCriteria.statement: Onward is the General's other 1-Command Order, so Field Command can allow Onward at its next legal timing that turn without spending Command.

cases.question: I accidentally revealed one of my own Tactics early, before its normal reveal, and both players saw it. Does published v0.7.1 define an official rollback or repair procedure for that mistake?

semanticCriteria.statement: Published v0.7.1 does not define an official rollback or repair procedure for this accidental early reveal; the Arbiter should identify the gap and give a clearly provisional table ruling.

cases.question: Which Gauntlet Leader is the easiest one for a new player to win with?

semanticCriteria.statement: This asks for strategic or comparative advice rather than a gameplay-rules ruling, so the Rules Arbiter should give a concise scope boundary.
